stem.text: An object moves from rest with uniform velocity horizontally and uniform acceleration vertically.
Which graph showing the variation with time of the displacement of the object from its initial position is correct?

A.alt: Graph: vertical axis labelled horizontal displacement, horizontal axis labelled time, both starting at 0; one curve starts at the origin.

B.alt: Graph: vertical axis labelled vertical displacement, horizontal axis labelled time, both starting at 0; one curve starts at the origin.

C.alt: Graph: vertical axis labelled horizontal displacement, horizontal axis labelled time, both starting at 0; one curve starts at the origin.

D.alt: Graph: vertical axis labelled vertical displacement, horizontal axis labelled time, both starting at 0; one curve starts at the origin.
